name: Hamstring Stretch
description: Stretches the back of the thigh lying down at a doorway: rest one heel up the wall or door frame and gently straighten the knee.

source.title: Mayo Clinic: A guide to basic stretches

setup: Lie on the floor by the outer corner of a wall or door frame, left leg next to the wall. (The line shows the door frame; your other leg goes through the doorway.)
cues: Start with the knee slightly bent.
Straighten until you feel a stretch along the back of the thigh.
More stretch as you get flexible: shuffle closer to the wall.

prescription.note: Hold about 30 seconds and repeat 2 to 4 times on each side. Warm up for 5 to 10 minutes first, move slowly, don't bounce, and back off if it hurts.

keyframes.name: Lie by the doorway
keyframes.cue: Lie on your back, left leg beside the wall.

keyframes.name: Heel on the wall
keyframes.cue: Raise your left leg and rest the heel on the wall, knee slightly bent.

keyframes.name: Straighten the leg
keyframes.cue: Gently straighten your left leg until the back of the thigh stretches.
